import java.util.Scanner;

public class CF1342E_1 {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k >= n) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int c = n - (int) k;
        int length = n + n;
        int[] fact = new int[length];
        int[] invFact = new int[length];

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                fact[i] = 1;
            } else {
                fact[i] = (int) ((long) fact[i - 1] * i % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (length > 0) {
            invFact[length - 1] = modPow(fact[length - 1], MOD - 2);
            for (int i = length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                invFact[i - 1] = (int) ((long) invFact[i] * i % MOD);
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int a = 1; a <= c; a++) {
            long term = modPow(a, n) * choose(fact, invFact, c, a) % MOD;
            if (((c - a) & 1) == 0) {
                ans += term;
            } else {
                ans -= term;
            }
        }

        ans %= MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        ans = ans * choose(fact, invFact, n, c) % MOD;
        if (k > 0) ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static int modPow(int a, int e) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = a;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * base % MOD;
            base = base * base % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static long choose(int[] fact, int[] invFact, int n, int k) {
        return (long) fact[n] * invFact[k] % MOD * invFact[n - k] % MOD;
    }
}

public class CF1342E_3 {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;
    static final BigInteger BIG_MOD = BigInteger.valueOf(MOD);
    static final BigInteger EXP = BigInteger.valueOf(MOD - 2);

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringBuilder all = new StringBuilder();
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
            all.append(line).append(' ');
        }
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(all.toString());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        if (k >= n) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int c = n - (int) k;
        int size = n + n;
        long[] fact = new long[size];
        long[] invFact = new long[size];

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            fact[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
            invFact[i] = modInverse(fact[i]);
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int a = 1; a <= c; a++) {
            long pow = BigInteger.valueOf(a).modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(n), BIG_MOD).longValue();
            long term = pow * choose(fact, invFact, c, a) % MOD;
            if (((c - a) & 1) == 0) {
                ans += term;
            } else {
                ans -= term;
            }
        }

        ans %= MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        ans = ans * choose(fact, invFact, n, c) % MOD;
        if (k > 0) ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static long modInverse(long x) {
        return BigInteger.valueOf(x).modPow(EXP, BIG_MOD).longValue();
    }

    static long choose(long[] fact, long[] invFact, int n, int k) {
        return fact[n] * invFact[k] % MOD * invFact[n - k] % MOD;
    }
}

import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class CF1342E_5 {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;

    static class ModArith {
        static long pow(long a, int e) {
            long res = 1;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * a % MOD;
                a = a * a % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        static long mul(long a, long b) {
            return a * b % MOD;
        }
    }

    static class Comb {
        private final int[] fact;
        private final int[] invFact;

        Comb(int max) {
            fact = new int[max];
            invFact = new int[max];
            if (max > 0) {
                fact[0] = 1;
                for (int i = 1; i < max; i++) {
                    fact[i] = (int) ModArith.mul(fact[i - 1], i);
                }
                invFact[max - 1] = (int) ModArith.pow(fact[max - 1], MOD - 2);
                for (int i = max - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    invFact[i - 1] = (int) ModArith.mul(invFact[i], i);
                }
            }
        }

        long choose(int n, int k) {
            return ModArith.mul(fact[n], ModArith.mul(invFact[k], invFact[n - k]));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out, true);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k >= n) {
            out.println(0);
            out.flush();
            return;
        }

        int c = n - (int) k;
        Comb comb = new Comb(n + n);

        long ans = 0;
        for (int a = 1; a <= c; a++) {
            long term = ModArith.mul(ModArith.pow(a, n), comb.choose(c, a));
            ans += ((c - a) & 1) == 0 ? term : -term;
        }

        ans %= MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        ans = ModArith.mul(ans, comb.choose(n, c));
        if (k > 0) ans = ModArith.mul(ans, 2);

        out.println(ans);
        out.flush();
    }
}
